items.name: Shekla Tibs
items.desc: Beef sizzling in a clay pot over hot coals, with onion, pepper and rosemary.

items.name: Key Tibs Firfir
items.desc: Tibs in a rich berbere sauce, tossed with torn injera.

items.name: Doro Wot
items.desc: Chicken slow-cooked in berbere and spiced butter, with a boiled egg.

items.name: Kikil (goat meat stew)
items.desc: Tender goat in a mild, golden turmeric broth.

items.name: Zilzel Tibs
items.desc: Strips of beef, pan-fried with jalapeño and onion.

items.name: Gored Gored
items.desc: Raw beef cubes in spiced butter and mitmita, for the brave.

items.name: Mixed Dish
items.desc: A variety of wots on one big injera. Everything, together.

items.name: Vegetable Mix Platter
items.desc: Lentils, shiro, cabbage, greens and beans on injera. Reviewers say order it to try a bit of everything.

items.name: Shiro Tegamino
items.desc: Silky spiced chickpea stew, bubbling in its clay pot.

items.name: Bozena Shiro
items.desc: Shiro with tender beef, peppers and onion.

items.name: Fasolia
items.desc: Green beans and carrots, gently sautéed.

items.name: Buna
items.desc: Ethiopian coffee, poured from the jebena.

items.name: Coffee ceremony for the table
items.desc: Beans roasted, ground and brewed at your table, with popcorn and incense. Three rounds: abol, tona, baraka.
